spec.document: South Carolina D282 Software Developers Implementation Guide (FTA MFETv4.2), with the SC Schema Requirement Details and the Validation and Business Rules spreadsheets
spec.version: D282 April 2026, schema requirements Rev. 2026-06-26, validation rules Rev. 7-27-2026
spec.note: the transporter return conforms to every checked rule in this version. the rules that change live in the two spreadsheets, not the guide. the bol, net and gross tests follow them (document number up to 15 characters and not 0, quantities any whole number up to 18 digits, negative on an amended return).

tests.name: BOL is missing, 0, or over 15 characters
Net is not a whole number of up to 18 digits
Gross is not a whole number of up to 18 digits
Shipper TCN missing or Invalid Format
Supplier Tax ID is not a 9 digit number
Consignor Tax ID is not a 9 digit number
Consignee Tax ID is not a 9 digit number
